modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Jute weft winding

pcs.pc_description: reach at least 10 - 15 minutes early to the work place
bring the necessary operational tools (knife, gauge) to the department
collect from the operator in previous shift the information regarding the jute yarn count being processed
follow norms of quality, production norms, safety norms or any other specific instructions, etc
understand the count of yarn produced, colour codes followed in the cop winding
ensure availability of full spinning bobbins (the feed material) for jute cop winding machine
ensure cleanliness of the machines & other work areas
check whether any spare / raw material/lubricant / tool / yarn / any other material are thrown on the ground or under the machines or in the relevant work place
run the machine smoothly
ensure in providing the details regarding count of jute weft yarn, colour coding followed in spinning and winding as per allocated number of cop spindles or machines
provide all relevant information regarding the jute count produced, and idle spindle of cop winding machine
ensure proper functioning of the machine and report to the supervisor if there is any anomalies or problem found

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming Jute Weft Winding Operator in proper manner and get clearance from the incoming counterpart
report to the supervisor and incoming Jute Weft Winding Operator if there is any quality change and maintenance work done/or left during his shift

report to the supervisor all specific observations for all running jute spinning and winding machinery (about their running / shortages of feed materials, if any / maintenance required / done in any of machinery and absenteeism of workman)

pcs.pc_description: pick up yarn bobbins (feed material) and place them on the bobbin spindles as required
ensure that the bobbins of correct yarn count are taken for feeding
patrol around the cop winding machine and to notice the time of exhaustion, if any, for fed yarn spinning bobbins to the cop winding machine
ensure proper placement of the yarn bobbin in the holder and its tension,
ensure that minimum time is taken for creeling the yarn bobbins
replace the empty feed bobbins with full ones and put the empty bobbins on the conveyer/ box
report about the defective feed bobbin, if any
ensure that the spinning yarn bobbin is fully consumed
ensure safety while creeling and joining or knotting the yarn
use hand knotters for knotting the broken yarn or during cop change and during yarn breakage
take minimum time for knotting using weavers knot
ensure that the knots are of good strength, small in size and of minimum tail ends
remove thick places of jute yarns, slubs, etc., if visible during knotting.
refrain from joining yarn without knotting
pull yarn from bobbin through thread guide correctly
maintain uniform tension in all cop winding spindle heads
ensure uniform winding of the yarn on each cone(for cop)
ensure proper material handling of spinning bobbins, cops and empty bobbins

modules.module_title: Maintain work area, tools, material handling equipment and machinery for jute processing

pcs.pc_description: maintain personal hygiene and human safety, machine safety and specific dress code
carefully handle raw jute, slivers of jute, jute yarns and fabrics to minimize wastage
carefully handle all tools such as hand root cutter, circular blade motorized root cutter, chopper, wooden block, bale hook, rope cutter, picking hook, brooms etc
carefully handle moisture meter
carefully handle weigh machine

use proper mechanical handling equipment for lifting and handling jute and other materials, Mechanical Handling Equipment: hand barrow, can trolley, bobbin trolley, beam carrier, spool carrier, cloth carrier etc.
keep all waste jute materials in a specified place for further processing
maintain a clean and hazard free working area, keeping floors free from all encumbrances
maintain tools and equipment being used for jute processing
carry out scheduled running maintenance like shift-wise cleaning and oiling in respective jute processing machinery
report to supervisor for any abnormal sound, from any machine for jute processing
report to supervisor all anomalies and unsafe conditions of equipment and other unprecedented occurrences
ensure that the doors and covers for gear side/ belt side of the jute machinery are kept properly closed and all machine guards are in appropriate place
ensure that standing place in working position are free from all encumbrances, to maintain correct posture of working/sitting/standing during working in respective jute processing machinery
use appropriate cleaning equipment like knife, brooms, pliers, screw driver etc. and follow appropriate cleaning methods for the work to be carried out in particular jute processing machine
stack/dispose jute fibre/sliver/yarn waste safely in the designated location/place/bag to help usage of all wastages for further processing
store all gadgets, tools and cleaning equipment safely after their use in designated place after cleaning them properly
carry out cleaning and minor/small maintenance jobs for each jute processing machine as per schedule within limits of specific responsibility, as instructed
